info.name: Garrison
info.description:
Garrison REST, A2A, and MCP APIs (v0.2.0).

Select the Garrison environment, start a server and a worker that has `garrison-fake-harness` on its PATH, and run the collection top to bottom. The Auth folder signs in and stores a session token that every later request uses; the folders in between create resources with unique names and exercise every route; Cleanup deletes them again. The last folder restarts the server, so leave it out against shared servers.

Environment variables: `baseUrl`, `mcpUrl`, `tenantId`, `email`, `password`, `adminApiKey`, `accessKey`, `secretKey`, `nodeAccessKey`, `nodeSecretKey`. Identifiers created along the way are stored as collection variables.

See REST_API.md, MCP_API.md, A2A_API.md, and WEBSOCKETS_API.md in the repository for the full reference.

item.name: Pipelines
item.description: Pipelines run agents as ordered stages on one request: each stage is an ordinary run of its agent, sees the earlier stages' results through its PipelineStage prompt template, and can wait for a person to approve, request changes, or reject. This folder creates a two-stage pipeline on the Postman agent, runs it through a revision and an approval, exercises cancel, retry, and the 409 cases, and deletes everything it made, so it must run before Cleanup deletes the agent. Definitions need Pipeline permissions, pipeline runs need PipelineRun, and stage reviews need Read or Update on Approval. Run tokens cannot use any of these routes. See docs/PIPELINES.md and the Pipelines section of REST_API.md.

request.description: Creates a pipeline with two stages on the Postman agent. Stages run in list order and get positions 1 and 2. The second stage uses the agent's weighted deployment selection and may run twice when it fails. Needs Create on Pipeline. Validation failures answer 400 ValidationFailed with field codes such as PipelineEmpty, TooManyStages, ReferenceNotFound, DeploymentAgentMismatch, and TemplateKindMismatch; a duplicate name answers 409 NameConflict.
